intro: Read a Spanish job advert and learn vocabulary for applications, working conditions and employment.

la oferta de trabajo.en: the job vacancy; the job advert
la oferta de trabajo.nota: Depending on context, this can refer to a vacancy or the advert announcing it.

despedir.nota: In some present-tense forms, e changes to i: despido, despides, despide, despiden; the nosotros and vosotros forms keep e: despedimos, despedís.

el presupuesto.en: the budget; the estimate or quote
el presupuesto.nota: In a service or business context, a presupuesto is often an estimate or quote for work.

en prácticas.en: as an intern, as a trainee

autónomo.nota: Used as a noun or adjective for someone self-employed; the feminine form is autónoma.

se requiere.nota: In a job advert, the verb agrees with the following noun: se requiere experiencia; se requieren dos años de experiencia.

se ofrece.nota: In a job advert, the verb agrees with the following noun: se ofrece un contrato; se ofrecen buenas condiciones.

el candidato.nota: The feminine form is la candidata.

el empleado.nota: The feminine form is la empleada.

el estudiante en prácticas.nota: The feminine form is la estudiante en prácticas.

el funcionario.nota: The feminine form is la funcionaria.

bloques.texto:
Many job adverts use **se** to leave the employer unnamed: **se busca una persona**; **se buscan dos personas**. In this pattern, the verb agrees with the noun that follows. You may also see **se requiere** experiencia, **se ofrece** un contrato or **se valorará** el inglés.

A vacancy may require **experiencia**, **formación**, **idiomas**, **disponibilidad** or a **carné de conducir**. It may offer a **contrato**, a **sueldo**, a flexible **horario**, training paid for by the company or the possibility of **ascenso**. Conditions vary from one job to another.

The application steps are to **enviar el currículum** and a covering letter, **acudir a una entrevista** and, if selected, **firmar el contrato**. Later, someone may **despedirte**; you may **dimitir** or **jubilarte**.

A worker may be **empleado/a**, **estudiante en prácticas**, **autónomo/a** or **funcionario/a**. In an office, you can prepare an **informe**, a **presupuesto** or a **presentación**, and work in **el departamento de ventas**, **el de contabilidad** or **el de recursos humanos**.

frases.es: Empresa de transportes busca administrativo para su oficina de Valencia.
frases.en: Transport company seeks an administrative assistant for its Valencia office.

frases.es: Se requieren al menos dos años de experiencia y un buen nivel de inglés.
frases.en: At least two years of experience and a good level of English are required.
analisis: al menos dos años de experiencia
y un buen nivel de inglés

frases.es: El candidato atenderá a los clientes y preparará informes y presupuestos.
frases.en: The candidate will deal with customers and prepare reports and estimates.

frases.es: Se ofrece un contrato de un año con horario flexible y formación a cargo de la empresa.
frases.en: A one-year contract with flexible hours and training paid for by the company is offered.
analisis: con horario flexible y formación a cargo de la empresa

frases.es: Hay posibilidad de ascenso para quien demuestre interés.
frases.en: There is a possibility of promotion for anyone who shows interest.

frases.es: Las personas interesadas deben enviar su currículum y una carta de presentación al departamento de recursos humanos.
frases.en: Applicants should send their CV and a covering letter to the human resources department.
analisis: su currículum y una carta de presentación

bloques.pregunta: Complete the advert: experience is required.
Someone who works for himself is…

opciones.explicacion: Lo despidieron means they dismissed him, and ayer means yesterday.

opciones.texto: They said goodbye to him yesterday.
opciones.explicacion: That would be se despidieron de él.

bloques.pregunta: According to the advert, what must candidates send?

opciones.A CV and a covering letter: Su currículum y una carta de presentación.
opciones.A report and a quote: Those are tasks of the job.
opciones.A photo and a contract: The advert does not ask for these.

bloques.correcta: A CV and a covering letter

bloques.pregunta: Complete: promotion for anyone who shows interest.

opciones.demuestra: Quien refers to nobody in particular yet.

bloques.frase: Se ofrece contrato de un año

bloques.texto:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (100–120 words).** Write a short covering letter for a job you would like.

**Speak (about 2 minutes).** Answer aloud the classic interview questions: tell me about yourself, your strengths, your weaknesses, why this job.

bloques.pregunta: Complete: Two people are wanted for the position.

opciones.Se busca: Use singular with one person: Se busca una persona.
opciones.Se buscan: The verb agrees with the plural noun personas.
opciones.Buscando: An infinitive or participle cannot complete this advert.
